Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor
     
  • Class
    Description
    Diagnostic
    A single editor diagnostic reported by an extension granted TextEditorPermission.DIAGNOSE through EditorContext.reportDiagnostics(java.lang.String, java.util.List<org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.Diagnostic>).
    Diagnostic.Kind
    Diagnostic severity, from most to least urgent.
    DocumentContext
    A loaded document, handed to extensions through
    invalid reference 
    TextEditorExtension#onDocumentOpened
    and
    invalid reference 
    TextEditorExtension#onDocumentSaved
    .
    EditorContext
    The capability facade the editor hands an extension at
    invalid reference 
    TextEditorExtension#onEditorStarted
    .
    EditorSinks
    The optional, permission-gated capability delegates the editor panel wires behind an EditorContext.
    EditorSinks.Builder
    Fluent builder for EditorSinks.
    ExtensionBroker
    The runtime that drives TextEditorExtension hooks on behalf of the editor panel.
    ExtensionBroker.ConfiguredContribution
    One toolbar contribution paired with the providerId of the extension that contributed it, so the editor can form a globally-stable toolbar-button key (providerId/contributionId) that survives two extensions reusing the same short contribution id.
    ExtensionBroker.ContributedAction
    One toolbar contribution paired with the category and display name of the extension that contributed it, so the manager can group actions.
    ExtensionRegistry
    Discovers and tracks TextEditorExtension implementations, and holds the user's enable / permission-grant decisions for each.
    ExtensionRegistry.LoadedExtension
    One discovered extension plus the user's decisions about it.
    ExtensionState
    The persisted enable/grant state of one discovered extension, serialised as one entry of extensions.json by the editor store.
    StructureSymbol
    One entry in a document's structural outline (a type, method, field or other named member), reported by an analysis extension through EditorContext.showStructure(java.lang.String, java.util.List<org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.StructureSymbol>) and rendered in the Structure panel.
    TextEditorManifest
    Immutable metadata an extension publishes through
    invalid reference 
    TextEditorExtension#manifest()
    : its identity, a human-readable blurb and the permissions it needs.
    TextEditorPermission
    A capability an extension declares in its TextEditorManifest and that the user must grant (through the extension manager) before the matching hook or EditorContext capability becomes live.
    ToolbarContribution
    A toolbar button contributed by an extension.
